en.headline: Maid cafe operator arrested over alleged molestation of 14-year-old employee
en.dek: A 35-year-old man was detained in Mong Kok after a Form Three student reported being touched on multiple occasions starting from her first day of work.
body: Police arrested the operator of a maid cafe in Mong Kok’s Dundas Square on Saturday on suspicion of molesting a 14-year-old employee, officers said.

The victim, a Form Three student, began working at the cafe on 7 August. According to a police source, the 35-year-old man surnamed Cheung hugged her around the waist on that day and later made her sit on his lap for intimate photographs while touching her waist and breasts.

The girl reported the matter to police on 14 August. Officers from the Mong Kok crime squad also recovered some pornographic pictures of children at the premises. The man faces allegations of indecent assault of a girl under 16 and of using, procuring or offering a person under 16 for the making of pornography. He remained in custody pending further inquiries.

zh.headline: 旺角女僕咖啡店負責人涉非禮14歲女員工被捕
zh.dek: 中三女生8月7日首日上班起多次被觸碰，上周五報警，35歲男負責人周六被捕，另檢獲兒童色情照片。
body: 警方表示，旺角登打士廣場一間女僕咖啡店的35歲男負責人，涉嫌非禮一名14歲女員工，於周六被捕。
事主為中三女生，8月7日到該店首日上班。消息指，姓張負責人當日攬着她觸碰腰部，其後再讓她坐在大腿上拍攝親密照片，期間觸碰其腰部及胸部。
女生於8月14日報警。旺角警區重案組人員到場拘捕該名男子，並在店內檢獲一些兒童色情照片。他涉嫌猥褻侵犯16歲以下女童，以及利用、促致或提供未滿16歲的人製作色情物品，現正被扣留調查。
